assets.desc: a fallen mossy log lying on the ground. Bold readable silhouette with simple large shapes and strong value contrast so it stays recognizable when shrunk to a tiny pixel-art sprite; no tiny fussy details. Strong readable VOLUME like Project Zomboid sprites: one key light from the top-left, lit top-left surfaces, shaded right and lower parts, dark ambient-occlusion where it meets the ground, rounded masses built from 3-4 value steps; muted natural colours (not grey, not saturated)
